name: UIAble
summary: Freemium shadcn + Base UI React components; Community MIT free via @uiable registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free Community comps; Pro blocks/templates and @uiable-pro token-gated items excluded.
Requires Next.js 16+ / React 19 / Tailwind CSS v4 per installation docs.
components.json must register @uiable → https://uiable.com/r/{name}.json (documented in https://uiable.com/doc/cli).

components.name: Button
components.summary: React Aria/Base UI button with CVA variants.

demo.peerNotes: Free Community MIT tier via shadcn registry @uiable. Requires React 19 + Next.js 16+ + Tailwind v4 + Base UI peers. Pro (@uiable-pro) excluded.

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @uiable/button
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://uiable.com/r/button.json
# Registry: add "@uiable": "https://uiable.com/r/{name}.json" to components.json

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export const Example = () => <Button variant="default">Click me</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use UIAble free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://uiable.com/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @uiable/button` after adding `@uiable` registry `https://uiable.com/r/{name}.json` to components.json (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://uiable.com/r/button.json`). Import from `@/components/ui/button`. Built on shadcn/ui + Base UI + Tailwind CSS v4. Home: https://uiable.com. Docs: https://uiable.com/doc/introduction. CLI: https://uiable.com/doc/cli. Repo: https://github.com/codedthemes/uiable. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codedthemes/uiable/master/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 CodedThemes). Pricing freemium — Community free comps only; Pro blocks/templates/@uiable-pro excluded.
